run_caveats: First-run data: All tickers lack prior-session OI snapshots; OI change is UNAVAILABLE across the entire watchlist. Under oi_missing_policy=block, no tickers can be flagged regardless of volume or price signals. | No historical options volume baseline: All tickers have INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY (0 sessions). Volume unusualness is assessed only via the volume-to-prior-OI proxy, which cannot distinguish between normal and elevated activity relative to each ticker's own baseline. | No call/put ratio hist

All five watchlist tickers have insufficient options volume history (1 session each; 20 required) for statistical comparison to their own baselines. Z-scores and ratio-to-median metrics are unavailable. | All tickers have insufficient call/put ratio history; tilt vs each ticker's own 30-day average cannot be determined. | Sector benchmarks (XLK, XLY, XLC) and market benchmark (SPY) also have insufficient history; sector-wide context is unavailable for all tickers. | All data fetched during REGUL
